applied_to_demand.source: DhaTraX v1.0, Traffic_Analysis/vehicle_class_composition_by_site.csv, the three sites pooled (69,083 crossings)
applied_to_demand.citation: Roy, Arnob. "DhaTraX" (version 1.0). Zenodo, 2026. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22157752. CC BY 4.0.
applied_to_demand.simulated_as: each class is drawn at its share and driven as the nearest SUMO vehicle class with SUMO's own default parameters for that class; SUMO has no CNG auto-rickshaw or cycle-rickshaw class, and no Dhaka-specific size, speed or lane behaviour is modelled

vehicle_mix.sumo_check: sumo ran the 900 vehicles for 1800 simulated seconds on the frozen network: 900 inserted, no route error (first attempt failed on a turn closed to a class; the assignment now checks turns as well as roads)

twin_in_browser.page_says: Vehicle classes are drawn at counted shares (Car_Micro 33.15 %, Motor_Cycle 29.88 %, CNG 22.46 %, Rickshaw 4.39 %, and others). Counted: vehicles crossing one approach at each of three fixed cameras in Dhaka on 6, 19 and 20 April 2026, about 06:00 to 19:00, classified by the DhaTraX authors' detection model; a model's output at three places, not a census of the city. In the simulation: each class is drawn at its share and driven as the nearest SUMO vehicle class with SUMO's own default parameters for that class; SUMO has no CNG auto-rickshaw or cycle-rickshaw class, and no Dhaka-specific size, speed or lane behaviour is modelled. Source: Roy, Arnob. "DhaTraX" (version 1.0). Zenodo, 2026. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22157752. CC BY 4.0.

limits: the classes are SUMO's nearest classes with SUMO's default parameters; CNG is driven as a SUMO taxi and a cycle rickshaw as a SUMO bicycle
